title: AzureDevOpsPipelineProcessor
description: Azure DevOps Processor that migrates Taskgroups, Build- and Release Pipelines.

BuildPipelines.description: List of Build Pipelines to process. If this is `null` then all Build Pipelines will be processed.

Enabled.description: If set to `true` then the processor will run. Set to `false` and the processor will not run.

Enrichers.description: List of Enrichers that can be used to add more features to this processor. Only works with Native Processors and not legacy Processors.

MigrateBuildPipelines.description: Migrate Build Pipelines. A definition that already exists in the target (matched by name) is skipped and does not affect the result. A selected build pipeline that is not migrated, because it uses a task that is not installed in the target, uses a task group or variable group that was not migrated, or is rejected by the target, marks the run as failed (exit code 1).

MigrateReleasePipelines.description: Migrate Release Pipelines. A definition that already exists in the target (matched by name) is skipped and does not affect the result. A selected release pipeline that is not migrated, because it uses a task group or variable group that was not migrated, or is rejected by the target, marks the run as failed (exit code 1).

MigrateServiceConnections.description: Migrate Service Connections **secrets need to be entered manually**. A definition that already exists in the target (matched by name) is skipped and does not affect the result. A service connection the target rejects marks the run as failed (exit code 1).

MigrateTaskGroups.description: Migrate Task Groups. The versions of a task group are migrated together, lowest first. A task group that already exists in the target (matched by name) is skipped. If a version uses a task that is not installed in the target, that version and every higher version are skipped, because a version can only be created on top of the versions below it. A skipped task group, or a version the target rejects, marks the run as failed (exit code 1); task groups that already exist in the target do not.

MigrateVariableGroups.description: Migrate Variable Groups. A definition that already exists in the target (matched by name) is skipped and does not affect the result. A variable group the target rejects marks the run as failed (exit code 1).

RefName.description: `Refname` will be used in the future to allow for using named Options without the need to copy all of the options.

ReleasePipelines.description: List of Release Pipelines to process. If this is `null` then all Release Pipelines will be processed.

RepositoryNameMaps.description: Map of Source Repository to Target Repository Names

SourceName.description: This is the `IEndpoint` that will be used as the source of the Migration. Can be null for a write only processor.

TargetName.description: This is the `IEndpoint` that will be used as the Target of the Migration. Can be null for a read only processor.
